term: pointwise forward validity over all world predicates
definition: ForwardAt F w quantifies over every G:W→Prop and states NecessaryIf F G w → Dia F G w → Box F G w. This is a frame property at a fixed standpoint, not a claim about a single chosen God predicate. It permits the characteristic reachability predicate needed for the exact converse. Restricting to a corpus inventory or a proposed divine essence does not license the converse.
note: Mathematical quantification only; no source attribution or metaphysical completeness of admissible predicates is assumed.
